title: SEC filing: Hasbro confirms a cyberattack and says it may take "several weeks" before the incident is resolved, after detecting an intrusion on March 28 (Zack Whittaker/TechCrunch)
summary: Zack Whittaker / TechCrunch: SEC filing: Hasbro confirms a cyberattack and says it may take “several weeks” before the incident is resolved, after detecting an intrusion on March 28 — American toy-making giant Hasbro has confirmed a cyberattack, and the company says it may take “several weeks” before the incident is resolved.
contentText:
Zack Whittaker / TechCrunch :

SEC filing: Hasbro confirms a cyberattack and says it may take “several weeks” before the incident is resolved, after detecting an intrusion on March 28   —  American toy-making giant Hasbro has confirmed a cyberattack, and the company says it may take “several weeks” before the incident is resolved.
